The '''WADD''', short for '''Warning and Detection Device''', was a unit designed by the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his [[Droid/Legends|droids]] installed a network of the delicate-yet-sophisticated security units at [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] warehouse at [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].
